items.description: Download this premium, production-ready arabesque pattern optimized for high-end manufacturing. Available in fully scalable DXF, SVG, and DWG formats, this classic design features elegant symmetrical swirls and damask-inspired floral motifs. Ideal for fabricators creating luxury room dividers, privacy screens, and decorative interior wall panels.
